purpose: Audit multiple family-owned native or recipe proof packets as one route-aware system without changing their visual composition.
source_family_id: The exact package family_id in its build report; an assembly may explicitly group several package IDs under one family without guessing identity from names.
pin: Each build report is a packet-relative path and lowercase SHA-256. Native and recipe output PDF and preview bytes are rechecked against the report; native staged sources are checked against the original manifest.
output_key: route-id/output-id distinguishes variants and different source systems without collapsing product slicks or route studies.
coverage: Only selected-for-now, light-context outputs with explicit baseline slots can fill a baseline proof slot. Unselected route outputs remain experimental. Historical web source remains source-only.
review: Signature features become per-output review checklists; audit never asserts those features were visually preserved. Actual visual, browser, print, rights, and customer approvals require separate evidence.
